description: This file contains a suite of shell script functions and tests for handling git rebase operations involving submodules, including interactive rebase and handling modified submodules. It primarily defines functions for testing git rebase behavior in a submodule context.

methods.name: git_rebase
methods.description: Performs a git rebase with preparatory steps such as checking status, creating a new branch, adding and reverting changes, and then executing the rebase with a provided parameter.

methods.name: git_rebase_interactive
methods.description: Similar to git_rebase but executes an interactive rebase with a fake editor setup, including handling of special files within the '.git/info' directory.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_func
methods.description: A test function that calls either git_rebase or git_rebase_interactive based on its input, testing rebase behavior with submodules.
